open_points.text: check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values: the OUTSIDE_FORM member of = models.RefusalKind for an alias longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, a floor area that is not a decimal number, written as text of one or more ASCII digits, the first not the digit zero unless it is the only digit before the full stop or the end, optionally followed by a full stop and one or more ASCII digits, with no sign and no exponent, or is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, a number of rooms that is not a whole number, written as text of an optional hyphen-minus and one or more ASCII digits, the first digit not the digit zero unless it is the only one and no hyphen-minus before a lone zero, or is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, or a floor that is not a whole number so written; no other text is a number, a decimal comma, a plus sign, white space and a leading zero included; the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member for an object kind outside = models.ObjectKind, a customer language outside = models.CustomerLanguage or a customer kind outside = models.CustomerKind.
open_points.other_text: from app.models import CustomerKind, CustomerLanguage, FailedValue, GivenFormValue, GivenText, ObjectKind, RefusalFailure, RefusalKind, RepeatFacts, TextReading
open_points.question: The requirement must identify the FormField members that distinguish alias, floor area, rooms, floor, object kind, language and customer kind, and IMPORTS/runtime model surface must expose FormField with those members; otherwise the function cannot select the required validation without inventing enum members or values.
